state_meaning: AI-drafted candidate; no person has reviewed it.
text: The paper builds on the passages, questions and arguments from Parrish et al. (2022) and hires professional writers through Upwork (10 of 15 qualified freelancers from 32 proposals) to write a counter-argument against one of the two existing arguments per question, in sets of six passages with 10-14 questions each. Writers are explicitly instructed to respond to their assigned argument rather than just answer the question or support an option independently.
title: Counter-argument writing: professional writers rebut existing single-turn debate arguments
